content:
- removed the board size line
- hopefully fixed the repetition detection

struct's old contribution: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/81076c184b40736253f4c9e4905ce43f33c6

- changed config to board size (it's constant, it's always 7, many other board games have it)
- added some tooltips i.e. regarding who make 3rd repetition
- added legal actions to the inputs; to discuss if keep it: theoretically they can rarely exceed 200 moves in holeless specific positions

Known issues: some issues with 3rd-fold repetition, sometimes it end prematurely.

Ataxx at least! Upvoted ! And kudos to struct too! You will please NNers.

Some remarks:
* IMHO, the config line is not needed. The board description is enough. I'd say the player id is convenient but you can guess it too from the first turn.
* On the statement: Jump: A player may jump from a cell to another cell that is two squares away in any direction(both vertically and horizontally). He can also jump two cells diagonally. The statement is wrong but the game mechanics are correct.
Changed to config to board size. I know it's constant, but many other board games have it.
Make it simpler. Remove the line
